question: Can the released archive, before any candidate pixel is opened, provide the exact carriers and independent controls needed to distinguish rigid lunar terrain, Earth-emergence-linked glare or bloom, a cabin/window-only effect, and an external diffuse anomaly for Koch's 23:22:39.010 UTC gray-feature report?
terminal_objective: Decide whether an image-state canary can be causally interpretable enough to justify opening event pixels, or close the gray-feature lane at the current archive boundary.
authority: Read-only public-source research and private local repository updates only. No candidate-pixel access, publication, outreach, scientific acceptance, or external effect.

contract_lineage.inherited_pass_rule: Admit only an image-state canary capable of distinguishing rigid terrain, Earth-linked glare, cabin/window-only appearance, and an external diffuse anomaly.
contract_lineage.inherited_fail_rule: If exact products, cross-carrier coverage, or a discriminating control are missing, close the lane as SOURCE_CONTROL_INSUFFICIENT.
contract_lineage.anti_retrofit: Stage 9B formalizes and verifies the inherited four-way discriminator after metadata discovery; it may not weaken that discriminator because synchronous D5 frames were found.

admission_rule: Every required dimension must be PASS. PARTIAL is not sufficient. A camera absence cannot refute the crew unless viewpoint and sensitivity are comparable.

expected_result.claim_ceiling: Stage 9B establishes the exact PCD3 event transcript, a synchronized five-frame D5 exposure bracket inside a 40-frame cabin sequence, one near-time external SAW frame, and the missing controls that prevent four-way causal discrimination. It does not inspect event pixels, establish what any frame shows, detect or exclude lunar dust, refute Koch, validate an external anomaly, or make a public scientific finding.

next_step_logic.recommended: Return to a truthful synthesis centered on the measurement-design gap: Artemis II produced a precisely timed human anomaly report and a synchronized cabin image burst, but not the calibrated, geometry-bound independent carrier required to adjudicate it.
next_step_logic.fail_action: Keep every gray-feature candidate pixel closed and close this image lane at the current archive boundary.
next_step_logic.secondary: The label-only activity-metadata integrity candidate remains eligible because it does not depend on this lane.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: Reopen only if a source changes the failed dimensions—for example an event-bound operator/window record plus optical characterization and a calibrated comparable external low-light carrier. SPICE alone can improve geometry but cannot satisfy the optical or sensitivity controls.
